metadata.scenario: A new client inquires about setting up an initial consultation for financial planning services. Category: New Inquiry. Outcome: quote_provided. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Patricia Wilson. I was referred by Dr. Anderson. Nice to meet you, Patricia! What can I assist you with today? I’m looking for post-surgery care for my mother after her hip replacement. Of course! We offer specialized post-surgery recovery care. That sounds great. Can you tell me more about it? Sure! Our post-surgery recovery care includes support for up to 3 hours, priced between $85 and $110. What does that care include specifically? It involves monitoring her recovery, assisting with daily activities, and ensuring medication management. That sounds perfect. How soon can we start this service after her surgery? Typically, we can arrange for care to begin right after her discharge from the hospital. Good to know. Will you need a doctor’s note or any specific paperwork? Yes, we would need a doctor's order to start care, along with any relevant medical history. Alright. Do you offer any financial planning services for this? We can help with insurance authorization and discuss payment options during our consultation. That would be helpful. How do I set up an initial consultation? You can set it up by speaking with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen. What’s her number? You can reach her directly at +13165559203, or I can take your details and have her call you. Please have her call me. Absolutely! Can I have your preferred contact number and a good time for her to reach you? Sure, my number is +13165558471, and I'm available after 3 PM. Thank you, Patricia! I’ll pass that along to Lisa. I appreciate it! Could you also provide a quote for ongoing services? Yes, I can give you a range based on the types of care we discussed. That would be helpful. For regular post-surgery support, it typically ranges between $85 and $110 per visit. Okay, thank you for the information! Thank you for calling, Patricia! We’ll get in touch soon. Thank you! Bye! Bye!
